title: Два грецких ореха
alt: Story of War: Futatsu no Kurumi / Two Walnuts ふたつの胡桃
description: Futatsu no Kurumi is a short story following 12-year-old Ayaka as she is teleported back in time to the fire bombing of Tokyo in 1945 and covers her experiences in this very different and unfamiliar environment.
